reviews.title: Good Experience
reviews.text: Long flight. Seats average size. We had an empty seat between us! Great movie selection, which matters on a long ride. Food descent. Enjoyed breakfast. Staff did a good job. Landing was excellent.

reviews.author: globalminer

reviews.title: A Small budget airline based in the smaller airport in Beijing
reviews.text: This is a small budget airline funded by PLA, now it has 46 B737-800. It based in smaller Beijing airport so much less traffic so it saves at least 30 min in taxi time on runway and more time on driving into city center. It is full economy class and it has very narrow seats. You have to pay for your luggage at about 5kg/$. Overall it is not a bad deal as it saves a lot time as it has no traffics jam in air, on runway and on expressway into city. No inflight entertainment at all expect magazines and food must buy.
reviews.author: Lingang

reviews.title: The wonderful real low-cost airline
reviews.text: They are reasonable. After I was taxed by Pobeda of Russia, I asked China united airline to charge me 5kgs of luggage, they ignored me and just charge the ticket only. I had no problem in checked-in and boarding. really nice trip.

reviews.title: United from Boise to Orlando via Denver
reviews.text: United First was the best. Enjoyed not only the space and food service, but the flight attendants were exceptional.
reviews.author: Keith G

reviews.title: Diverted United flight was no fun
reviews.text: Got to the airport in Amsterdam to find that they had a 5 hour power outage before we got there. There were 3 flights lined up at the United check in counter as 2 earlier flights had been delayed and the line wound around the building. They had 4 (FOUR!) ticket agents for about 1100 people checking in plus their baggage conveyor would not work to send bags through. We had to race through to get to our plane on time over 3 concourses and a bus trip. 2 hours out of Amsterdam the pilot said we were diverting to London Heathrow due to electrical issues (later heard it was an engine fire?) and that some United personnel would direct us once we got into the terminal. We had to go out of passport control, then had to figure out how to get to the United Desk which was not readily evident. THERE WERE NO UNITED FLIGHT REPS IN SIGHT.. Finally got to the United desk with one rep there and about 300 other passengers behind us needing to rebook. They did rebook us on a flight to Washington that day but because their system was too slow we did not show up in security screening and had to go back to ticketing to get a United Ticket agent to tell security it was ok to let us through. We then had to run for about 15 minutes in order to make the new flight and they closed the doors behind us. During this alternate flight, the electronic entertainment system went out and had to be rebooted. After we got on the final flight going home from Washington, the steward said there would be a delay until extra generators could be accessed as their generator(s) had stopped working. By this time any mention of an electrical/power issue was very unwelcome!! We made it home by midnight. United did offer a $200 eCredit per person as compensation for the hassle of the diverted flight and they did this without being asked!
reviews.author: ddjd811

reviews.title: Some Fly attendances were not curtsy and polite
reviews.text: We were invited to teach at a great Summer Camp at Shanghai, and travel with my US students. On the returned fly, there were a female fly attendant was very rude to yell at one of my young female students with the finger point at my student in public "You don't belong to this business class, go back immediately" just because my student went to Business Class to visit a friend. This ill mannered act was not acceptable, I went to talk to the fly attendant, she was still using the harsh language to me. I have to call the crew leader to report this incident. The leader apologized, but we never receive the official letter report as he promised. ie this should deserve the :The Friendly Flying Sky？
reviews.author: Terry W

reviews.title: Budget airline with budget service
reviews.text: Had a flight from Yichun to Beijing and only one option, China United Airline. At check in I tried to ask for a aisle seat in order to avoid being seated between snack eating 2 Chinese travelers. The guy at the desk was very grumpy and did not at any point try to answer the questions our group of 3 put forward. And sure enough, a middle seat between 2 people enjoying the homemade lunch was my spot for the 2,5 hour duration flight. To make the trip even more enjoyable we had a one hour delay in departure (the airport only has 2 departures every day) and to make the trip even more enjoyable the staff prepared the flight for landing 45 minutes before touchdown, so no music, no video no nothing just sit still while the pilot shakes the plane in for la slam dunk landing. If I have a choice I would choose another company in the further.
reviews.author: Knudsen_P

reviews.title: Opposite of previous flight!!
reviews.text: This was my second time flying China United Airlines and almost completely opposite experience from the first. The flight boarded early and left Tunxi Huangshan early! Flight attendants were professional and about as friendly as Chinese flight attendants are capable of. Low-cost airline, so no meal service and no drinks. Flight arrived about on time despite rough bouncy air along the way.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Only if you have to!
reviews.text: Flight departed from Nanyuan Airport in Beijing (not the main Capital Airport). Airport is small and crowded, without a lot of facilities. Check-in was nonetheless reasonably efficient. Security check was very slow. After wandering about the small terminal and reassuring myself that there was nothing of interest to buy, I settled in to wait for the flight. Turned out to be quite a long wait! The flight ended up leaving more than 2 hours late. Finally boarding the plane (737-800), I was disappointed to find that my "window" seat was actually adjacent to a solid fuselage wall (no actual window!). The seats were typically cramped. No food or drinks were provided (although it seemed that some snacks were briefly offered for sale). Flight itself was a bit bouncy, but eventually arrived in Huangshan nearly 3 hours late.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Keep the domestic airlines just for locals
reviews.text: In a recent trip to China, we had to transfer from Shanghai to Beijing. Out of a curiosity and because of a friendly family competition to visit the most airports around the world, we chose to fly to NAY. (Poor choice!). The day of our flight, it was raining very badly in Beijing so the inbound flight to PVG was delayed by 5 hours, our flight to NAY finally departed PVG at 7:30 PM from a 12:20 PM original departure time. Then it was diverted to Hohhot after the plane couldn't land in Beijing because of the rain. All this while the main airport in Beijing was open and receiving flights. We finally arrived in Beijing 28 hours later after spending the night in Hohhot. This experience was very difficult because the language barrier was strong with the crew barely speaking English, and the staff in Hohhot speaking no English at all. So the communication was very difficult in all phases of this flight. If you need to fly domestically in China, avoid low cost airlines as it might be more costly at the end based on their resources. Use major airlines with connections between the main airports of each respective city. However, besides all this, I have to be fair with the crew and airline operations from CUA because they provided us with lunch, dinner, and breakfast as well as a hotel free of charge to compensate for the weather delay. This was very valuable with the conditions and resources we had. In the USA, airlines don't compensate for weather delays, so we have to be grateful for the Chinese airline to be helpful in that area.
reviews.author: Ramón

reviews.title: Meet Expectation
reviews.text: I was rather hesitant when my China local agent booked a domestic flight from Yan'an to Beijing. Skeptical? Should I request for a change to train instead? However, due to time factor, I stick onto the flight. The budget palne is small and looks old, I sat behind the business class, separated by a drawn curtain during the flight. Other than that, there is no difference between the 2 classes, except, they were served with box meal & we got peanuts and plain water served in a bottle. The take-off and landing it was smooth. If not too fussy, the service is acceptable to that of any budget air service.
